purpose: Post-hoc contextual comparison with the previous SpaceNet experiment; not used for local epoch/checkpoint selection or threshold tuning.

evaluation_protocol.images: Manifest scenes without inference tiling or area filtering; resize as registered above
evaluation_protocol.nodata: Reference/prediction masks clipped to identical valid area, excluding declared uncertain regions; RGB unchanged
evaluation_protocol.fusion_diagnostic: Prediction covers >=50% of each of >=2 distinct reference roofs
evaluation_protocol.deployment_difference: Production uses 512px overlapping tiles and area/duplicate filtering

inference_dtype: float32 after strict loading of the prior float16 artifact

annotation_provenance.annotation_unit: visually distinguishable roof, not dwelling, occupancy or cadastral parcel

assessment_caveat: Evaluación piloto de una sola captura de Chullo con referencias visuales provisionales del asistente, sin revisión humana. La separación espacial no establece independencia de adquisición ni estadística. Los resultados no representan exactitud en toda Chullo ni Arequipa.
